::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 8\
**Prep time:** 15 minutes\
**Cook time:** 1 hour

[Main]{.badge .badge-main} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*Use spicier chilis depending on your mood.*

## Ingredients

- 4 eggs (beaten)
- 2 cans cream corn
- 1½ tsp garlic salt
- 1 cup corn meal
- 2 small cans mild chilis
- ½ lb cheddar (shredded)
- 1 tbsp oil
- 1 tsp salt

## Instructions

*Preheat the oven to 350°F.*

1. Mix the eggs, cream corn, oil, salt, garlic salt, and corn meal together.
2. Pour half of the mixture into a greased casserole dish.
3. Layer on the mild chilis and most of the cheddar.
4. Pour the remaining mixture on top.
5. Top with the remaining cheddar.
6. Bake for 1 hour.
